status: designed after inspecting only the 16 normal maxima for the yaw observer, before any yaw collision result
mechanical_motivation: The largest normally observed yaw-balance departures with load occurred late in the handoff, not uniformly across all movements. Use a conservative bound on normal amplitude, not the per-tick sign/noise pattern.
range: all times in the task; already-frozen grip + startup reset unchanged
bound: Per grip and 100ms bin maximum absolute angular torque across every normal training trial in this and both adjacent bins; add largest positive held-COM-group excursion beyond its other groups' neighborhood bound for that grip; apply 5 percent reserve. Fall back to global bound outside observed cells. No force labels used.
sensors: same frozen yaw-balance channel; current time, public task clock and grip only select the bound.
evaluate: Global and coarse variants reported separately against original complete official table; independent unopened noise/perturbation comparisons separate. Neither is R21 horizontal wrench observer nor the R10 submission.
